# Next

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Loops](Language-Features-Loops)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Next
```

## Description

Ends a [For](For) loop: the variable moves on, and the loop runs again or ends.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
For i = 1 To 2
	Print "pass " + i
Next
```

```text
pass 1
pass 2
```

## Related Commands

[For](For), [Forever](Forever), [Repeat](Repeat), [Step](Step)
